## Constant and field details

<a id="CircTweenEquation-constant-IN"></a>

### IN

`CircTweenEquation IN` 

Starts slowly, along quarter circles.

<a id="CircTweenEquation-constant-OUT"></a>

### OUT

`CircTweenEquation OUT`

### IN_OUT

`CircTweenEquation IN_OUT`
